@NeedleStack, I reorganized your CSS. I think it will be a lot easier to understand / maintain.

I also made a couple minor improvements:

  • There was a small space between your header image and the subverse menu, which I got rid of.

  • I changed your line-height values to a ratio, so you don't need to calculate it each time. e.g. line-height: 1.1; means 1.1 times the font-size.

  • I changed the flair selector to target all flairs, so you don't need to add display: inline-block; every time you add a flair type.

* {
 margin: 0;
}

html, body {
 height: 100%;
}

h1, h3 {
 font-family: Cambria, Georgia, serif;
 font-style: normal;
 font-variant: normal;
 font-weight: 500;
 line-height: 1.1;
}

h1 {
 font-size: 24px;
}

h3 {
 font-size: 14px;
}

p,
blockquote,
pre {
 font-family: Cambria, Georgia, serif;
 font-style: normal;
 font-variant: normal;
 font-weight: 400;
 line-height: 1.43;
}

p {
 font-size: 14px;
}

blockquote {
 font-size: 21px;
}

pre {
 font-size: 13px;
}

.flair:not(:empty) {
 display: inline-block;
}

#header {
 background: url("https://i.imgur.com/KvMX8Zq.jpg") top center no-repeat scroll;
 height: 257px;
}

.pagename a:after {
 font-family: Cambria, Georgia, serif;
 font-size: 17px;
 vertical-align: bottom;
}

#container .even {
 background: transparent;
}

#container .comment .comment {
 background: transparent;
}

.side .spacersection {
 display: none;
}

.spacersection + .spacersection {
 display: none;
}

.subscribers .word {
 display: none;
}

.subscribers .number:after {
 content: " Bookbinders";
}

.users-online .word {
 display: none;
}

.users-online .number:after {
 content: " bookbinder(s) studying";
}

.wrapper {
 min-height: 100%;
 height: auto !important;
 /* This line and the next line are not necessary unless you need IE6 support */
 height: 100%;
 margin: 0 auto -500px;
 /* the bottom margin is the negative value of the footer's height */
}

.footer, .push {
 height: 500px;
 /* .push must be the same height as .footer */
}

@media screen and (min-device-width: 1200px) { /* only screens wider than 1200px will be affected this CSS */

 body {
 background-image: url("https://i.imgur.com/17FR11L.jpg");
 background-repeat: no-repeat;
 background-attachment: fixed;
 background-size: 100%;
 }

} /* end of @media query */
